meta.title: SADEED | Interactive E-Learning Solutions
meta.description: SADEED builds virtual reality experiences, augmented reality solutions and educational games that transform how schools, universities and organizations teach and train.
meta.contactDescription: Partner with SADEED on VR, AR and educational game projects for your school, university or organization. Request a demo today.

hero.description: We design immersive VR experiences, AR learning tools and educational games that help learners understand more, remember longer and practise safely.
hero.visualAlt: 3D illustration of a VR headset rising from an open book on a beam of light, surrounded by a graduation cap, an atom and colorful pixels

solutions.title: Immersive learning, built for real classrooms
solutions.subtitle: Three ways we bring lessons to life, all designed with educators, delivered in Arabic and English, and built to run on the devices you already have.

vr.title: Virtual Reality Experiences
vr.description: Step inside the lesson with virtual labs, field trips and training simulations for standalone headsets.

ar.title: Augmented Reality Solutions
ar.description: Bring textbooks, models and equipment to life on phones and tablets with interactive 3D overlays.

games.title: Educational Games & Interactive Learning
games.description: Game-based learning that turns practice into play, with challenges, rewards and progress tracking.

why.title: Learning by doing, not just watching
why.subtitle: Immersive learning puts students inside the lesson. That changes how much they remember and how ready they feel.

speed.label: Faster to train
speed.description: Learners complete hands-on modules faster than with classroom instruction alone.

confidence.label: More confident
confidence.description: Learners feel more confident applying what they practised in a realistic environment.

safe.label: Real-world risk
safe.description: Practise dangerous or expensive procedures as often as needed, with no harm to people or equipment.

focus.label: More focused
focus.description: Headsets remove distractions, so learners stay on task far longer than on a laptop screen.

why.note: Figures from PwC, "The Effectiveness of Virtual Reality Soft Skills Training in the Enterprise" (2020), compared with classroom learners. Results vary by context and program design.

portfolio.title: Projects that make learning stick
portfolio.subtitle: A selection of experiences we have designed and built for learners of all ages.

process.title: From idea to impact
process.subtitle: A clear, collaborative process with your educators at every step.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: We meet your educators and experts to define learning outcomes, audience, hardware and success metrics.

design.title: Design
design.description: Storyboards, interaction design and prototypes, reviewed with you before production starts.

develop.title: Develop (Unity)
develop.description: We build in Unity with 3D art, Arabic and English content, and regular playable builds for your feedback.

deploy.title: Deploy & Support
deploy.description: Installation, teacher training, analytics and ongoing updates so the experience keeps delivering value.

about.title: Our mission is to transform how the Arab world learns
about.body1: SADEED is a team of educators, 3D artists and Unity engineers based in Amman, Jordan. We turn curricula, procedures and complex concepts into interactive experiences that learners can see, touch and explore.
about.body2: We work closely with teachers, subject-matter experts and decision-makers, so every experience is pedagogically sound, culturally relevant and fully bilingual.
about.mission: Make high-quality immersive learning accessible to every classroom and training centre in the Arab world.
about.approach: Learning outcomes first, technology second. We measure success by what learners can do afterwards.
